SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sr.id_student || '-' || sr.code_module || '-' || sr.code_presentation) 
FROM studentRegistration sr
JOIN studentAssessment sa ON sr.id_student = sa.id_student 
JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment = a.id_assessment 
  AND sr.code_module = a.code_module 
  AND sr.code_presentation = a.code_presentation
WHERE sr.date_unregistration IS NOT NULL
